am-kinematics-1d.statement: The velocity-time graph shows the motion of a particle in a straight line. Read the values from the graph.

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: Find the acceleration in the first stage.

parts.label: (b)
parts.prompt: Find the total distance travelled (the area under the graph).

parts.label: (c)
parts.prompt: Find the average speed for the whole journey.

solution: Distance = area: (1/2) x 4 x 8 + 7 x 8 + (1/2) x 6 x 8 = 96 m.
Average speed = total distance / total time = 96 / 17 = 5.65 m/s.

am-momentum-impulse.statement: A ball of mass 0.6 kg hits a wall at right angles with speed 18 m/s and rebounds along the same line with speed 13 m/s. The contact lasts 0.01 s.

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: Find the magnitude of the impulse the wall gives the ball.

parts.label: (b)
parts.prompt: Find the average force of the wall on the ball.

parts.label: (c)
parts.prompt: Find the coefficient of restitution between the ball and the wall.

solution: Take the rebound direction as positive: impulse = 0.6(13 - (-18)) = 18.6 N s.
e = speed of separation / speed of approach = 13/18 = 0.72.

am-resistive-forces.statement: A particle of mass 3 kg moves in a straight line against a resistance of magnitude 3kv newtons, where v m/s is its speed and k = 0.5 per second. Its initial speed is 13 m/s. No other horizontal force acts.

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: Find the speed after 4 seconds.

parts.label: (b)
parts.prompt: Find the total distance travelled before it comes to rest.

parts.label: (c)
parts.prompt: Find the time taken for the speed to fall to half its initial value.

solution: 3dv/dt = -3kv, so dv/dt = -0.5v. Separating: v = 13e^(-0.5t); at t = 4, v = 1.76 m/s.
Use a = v dv/dx = -0.5v, so dv/dx = -0.5 and v = 13 - 0.5x. It stops when x = 13/0.5 = 26 m.
Half speed: e^(-0.5t) = 1/2, so t = ln 2 / 0.5 = 1.39 s.
